approach: Add a pure `code_health` module in athena-core. It measures each tracked `.rs` file under `crates/` and `xtask/`: production lines (cut at `#[cfg(test)] mod` blocks), longest function (parsed with `syn`), landings in the last 7 days, and failure/rejection citations. The landing and citation counts come from records: landed jobs with `Outcome.at`, and the files their candidate commits changed. Test run time comes from the latest passing `test` CheckRun duration in the verification or baseline records. Thresholds are constants: file over 2000 lines, function over 200 lines, or over 1500 lines with 5 or more landings in 7 days. `StatusView` gets a `code_health` field and `display::status` renders the table. A `Athena::after_landing` hook calls `code_health::queue_structural_passes` and `queue_design_review_if_due`. The hook is called from the end of `Athena::land_pr` (when the link state is Landed) and from `note_finished` in steward.rs when a job lands. Requests are written as `athena.request/1` records on the steward channel through `Committer::commit_records`, in the same way `RequestQueue` does. The cadence baseline is derived from records. The latest request carrying a design-review marker is the baseline. With none, the baseline is the current landed count, so history alone never fires a review. Dedupe uses the marker line `Structural pass: <path>` in open (queued/proposed/dispatched) requests.

decisions.choice: Measure function length with `syn` (full feature, proc-macro2 span-locations) and record the call in docs/decisions.md.
decisions.reason: buy-first. syn is already in Cargo.lock, handles nested fns, impl methods, closures excluded, macros. Span line numbers give exact start and end lines.

rejected.why: Breaks on braces in strings, comments, raw strings and lifetimes; a maintained parser is available.
Gives pass/fail at one threshold, no per-file numbers for the status table, and no way to feed the queue.

decisions.choice: Derive the design-review baseline from records: the latest request whose text carries the design-review marker; if none, the baseline is the landed count now.
decisions.reason: Survives loss of the state directory (unlike the steward-count file). With no earlier review the first review waits 10 new landings and does not fire at once on old history.

rejected.option: A counter file in the state directory like steward::tick
rejected.why: Lost with state; resets cadence silently.
Fires immediately on existing history, which criterion 4 forbids.

decisions.choice: Count landings by Outcome state Landed with the outcome's `at` (and later_outcome for blocked-then-landed); map to files via the candidate commit's diff-tree.
decisions.reason: Records are the authority; same source in tests and production.

rejected.why: Records are on a separate branch; a squash-merged log does not name jobs, so failures could not be tied.

decisions.choice: Hook the check in two places: end of Athena::land_pr on a Landed link state, and note_finished for a landed job in the go path. Both call one idempotent function.
decisions.reason: Criterion 6 wants both the land_pr path and the finished-job hook shown. Idempotence (marker dedupe) makes a double call queue nothing extra.

rejected.why: land_pr is where the merge happens on the pull request route; go never sees it.

decisions.choice: A failure never blocks the landing: the hook returns warnings through ui.line, like watch_landing.
decisions.reason: The landing is already merged; a measuring fault must not turn it into an error.

rejected.why: Would report a done landing as failed.

decisions.choice: The design-review text is self-contained and carries `Priority: high` plus a design-only instruction.
decisions.reason: No design-review role exists. The request reader needs the full text and the plan parser reads the Priority line.

rejected.option: Reference a docs file for the instructions
rejected.why: The producer snapshot may lack context; the text must stand alone.

decisions.choice: Table header is built from the same width constants as the rows, so columns align to their labels.
decisions.reason: Fixes the earlier nit; a test asserts each header label starts at its column in the row.

files.purpose: Measure files (production lines, longest fn via syn, churn, citations, suite time), thresholds and breaches, structural-pass and design-review queueing, the Athena::after_landing hook, and unit tests.
Add `code_health` field to StatusView, filled in Athena::status.
Call the after-landing hook at the end of Athena::land_pr when the link state is Landed; warn, never fail.
Call the hook from note_finished for a landed job (skipped for nested runs).
Only if needed so the go path passes the finished job to the hook; otherwise untouched.
Add syn (full, visit) and proc-macro2 (span-locations) as dependencies.
Lock the added dependency features; syn 2.0.119 and proc-macro2 are already present.
Render the code-health table in `status` with aligned header columns, thresholds and suite time; add a render test.
Integration tests for the land_pr hook and the finished-job hook, with the disk minimum set to 0.
Unreleased entry for the code-health check, status table and design-review cadence.
Record thresholds, the syn buy-versus-build call, and the 10-landing cadence.

steps: Add syn (features full) and proc-macro2 (span-locations) to crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml; check the workspace dependency table and use `workspace = true` if it lists them; update Cargo.lock with `cargo build`.

Write code_health.rs: constants (2000, 200, 1500, 5, 7 days, 10 landings); `FileHealth` (path, production lines, longest fn, weekly landings, citations, over flag and reasons); production-line count cut at the first `#[cfg(test)]` module, preferring syn item spans; longest function over fns and impl methods using syn span lines.

Add record-derived inputs: landed jobs in window with the files their candidate commit changed (git diff-tree --name-only); failed/rejected/planning-stopped jobs citing a file (by changed files and path text in reasons); suite time from the latest passing test CheckRun duration.

Add `queue_structural_passes`: one `athena.request/1` per breaching file on the steward channel, text citing the measured numbers and a marker line `Structural pass: <path>`; skip when any queued/proposed/dispatched request carries that marker; commit via Committer::commit_records with Athena-Job trailers.

Add `queue_design_review_if_due`: baseline is the latest design-review-marked request, else the current landed count; fire at 10 landed jobs since, with `Priority: high` and the self-contained text (what to review, what to produce as a design-only job).
Add `Athena::after_landing(ui)` running both, printing warnings on error, skipped when nested. Call it at the end of land_pr (Landed state) and in note_finished for a landed job.
Add the StatusView field in status.rs; render the table in display.rs from shared width constants so header and rows align.
Write unit tests in code_health.rs and display.rs, and the integration file code_health_hooks.rs (set disk minimum to 0 as 3947eb3 does).
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked; fix anything that fails.

risks.risk: Landing records may not list a job's changed files, so churn cannot be tied to files.
risks.mitigation: Use git diff-tree on the candidate commit; if the commit is absent, count nothing for that job and add a test for that case.

risks.risk: The hook queues a request during a landing, and the records commit could race with the landing's own records writes.
risks.mitigation: Call it after land_pr's merge and records are done, use Committer, and treat errors as warnings.

risks.risk: Measuring many files with syn slows `athena status`.
risks.mitigation: Parse only tracked .rs files, once per status call; skip files that fail to parse and list them as unmeasured rather than failing.

risks.risk: Adding a StatusView field breaks existing literal constructions or JSON snapshot tests.
risks.mitigation: StatusView is built only in status.rs (grep showed one site); run the full test suite.

risks.risk: Landing tests run the low-disk guard on a small machine and fail for environment reasons (the earlier failure).
risks.mitigation: Set the disk minimum to 0 in the new tests, as 3947eb3 does for existing ones.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in code_health.rs builds a temp tree with a fixture .rs file (production code, a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` block, one long fn) and fixture records: landed jobs inside and outside 7 days touching it, plus a rejected and a failed job citing it. It calls `measure` and asserts the exact numbers.
demonstrations.observes: Production lines exclude the cfg(test) module; longest function equals the fixture's length; weekly landings counts only the in-window jobs; citations count the failed and rejected jobs.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the cfg(test) cutoff the line count includes the test module and the equality assertion fails; without the 7-day filter the old landing is counted.

demonstrations.method: Table-driven tests: a file of 2001 lines, a function of 201 lines, a 1501-line file with 5 landings in a week, a 1501-line file with 4 landings, and a small file. Each is run through `breaches`.
demonstrations.observes: The first three are reported with their reason; the 4-landing file and the small file are not.
demonstrations.fails_without: With a threshold removed, its case is not reported and the test fails; with an over-eager rule, the clean file is flagged.

demonstrations.method: Test over a temp git repository with records: after a breach `queue_structural_passes` writes one request record citing the path, line count, longest function and weekly landings. A second call queues none; an open structural-pass request for the file queues none.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one new athena.request/1 on the steward channel on the first call; zero on the second call and when a queued request for the file is open.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the dedupe the second call adds a second request and the count assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Test with synthetic landed-job records: a review request exists and 9 landings follow, then a 10th. Another case has no earlier review and 25 landed jobs of history.
demonstrations.observes: Nothing queued at 9; one request queued at the 10th, with Priority high (JobRecords::priority returns High). With no earlier review nothing is queued on the existing history.
demonstrations.fails_without: An off-by-one threshold queues at 9 or not at 10; a from-zero baseline fires at once on history.

demonstrations.method: Test reads the queued review request text and asserts it contains each required phrase.
demonstrations.observes: The text names the code-health table, files most changed and most broken since the last review, open structural-pass requests, recent rejections and planning stops; and asks for a short design note with proposed changes as a design-only job.
demonstrations.fails_without: A text missing any of those items fails the per-phrase asserts.

demonstrations.method: New integration test file crates/athena-cli/tests/code_health_hooks.rs. It sets the disk minimum to 0 as in 3947eb3. It drives Athena::land_pr with the fake host/remote seam on a repo whose file is over a threshold, then asserts a structural-pass request exists. It does the same for a landed job via the finished-job hook (note_finished or go).
demonstrations.observes: After land_pr lands, one structural-pass request is on the records branch; after a landed finished job, the same check ran. A control test with the hook call absent shows no request.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the hook call is removed from land_pr or note_finished, no request is queued and the assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Test renders `display::status` with a StatusView holding code-health rows and a test-suite time, and checks the table text. For each header label it finds the same column offset as in the row's fields.
demonstrations.observes: Output has a code-health section with lines, longest fn, weekly landings, citations, thresholds, an over yes/no, and the suite run time; header labels start at the same column as the values.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the section or a column is missing, the contains asserts fail; a misaligned header fails the offset assert.

demonstrations.method: Run the three gates and cite them in the evidence.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked

demonstrations.method: Read the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry and the docs/decisions.md entry.
demonstrations.observes: CHANGELOG has a code-health entry; decisions.md records the three thresholds, the syn-versus-hand-rolled call, and the 10-landing cadence.

open_questions: Whether the Candidate or Verification record lists changed files directly; if so use that instead of git diff-tree (not read).
Where a design-only job is flagged: the request text asks for it, but I did not confirm a request-level marker the reader recognises.
How 3947eb3 sets the disk minimum to 0 in tests (env var or config); the commit was not visible in the snapshot.
Whether the workspace Cargo.toml already lists syn/proc-macro2 under [workspace.dependencies].
